phase: Phase 17-MM - gravity-field model-mismatch masquerade falsification (K-closeout report section 3.4)
written: 2026-10-12, before any mismatch solve was run
hypothesis_H_mm: A Moon-fixed gravity-field error whose residual signature is statistically undetectable produces a significant false M3 K variation

design.truth_K: constant (T0_CONSTANT), K0 = 0.01 m2/kg on all three segments
design.seeds: identical to the KP2 T0 trial of each cell: rng([ci, 0, 0]) -> dx (a priori), range noise, per-pass bias, Doppler noise, in KP2 job_main order
design.truth_field: GL1800F 50x50 + alpha * (GRGM1200L 50x50 - GL1800F 50x50), built on the GL1800F model (mu, R = 1738 km, frame MOON_PA_DE440) with GRGM1200L coefficients rescaled to GL's mu and R: C_T = C_GL + alpha (C_GR mu_GR/mu_GL (R_GR/R_GL)^n - C_GL), n >= 2 (the engine's perturbing field; the central term is MU_MOON in both). Equivalent to a_GL + alpha (a_GR - a_GL), the linear-probe quantity
design.truth_dynamics: KP2 HIGH_FIDELITY (Earth/Sun third body, conical-penumbra SRP, harmonic STM) with the truth field in place of GL1800F 50x50; rtol 1e-12 / atol 1e-13 (KP2 HF_TOL)
design.estimator: KP2 M3 solver unchanged: phase17_kp2_core.solve(model='M3', bias_mode='FREE', dyn=HIGH_FIDELITY) with GL1800F 50x50, default staging and 1e-2 sigma convergence
design.baseline: the existing KP2 T0 trial of each cell (truth = model, same draws): stored theta; residuals recomputed at it; harness check: recomputed KP2 cost reproduces the stored cost within 1e-6 relative

measures.delta_chi2: data-only chi2 (whitened range + Doppler residuals at the solution) of the mismatch run minus that of the baseline; N = n_range + n_doppler
measures.runs_test: per pass Wald-Wolfowitz runs test on whitened residual signs (Doppler passes = the free-bias columns; range passes = per station, split at gaps > 600 s; passes with < 10 rows skipped); combined Stouffer Z over passes; reported per data type
measures.bias: level error (mean fractional K error) and |x0 error| / sigma per component

outcome_rule.H_MM_SURVIVES_MASQUERADE: some (cell, alpha) has chi2_detect >= 13.82 AND delta_chi2 <= 2 sqrt(2N) (both on converged solves); also reported: whether the runs test is blind there too
outcome_rule.H_MM_FALSIFIED: every converged run with chi2_detect >= 13.82 has delta_chi2 > 2 sqrt(2N), or no run reaches 13.82
outcome_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: a run that would decide the outcome did not converge

linear_prediction_recorded: alpha = 1: detectable, large false variation (CANON, O1, O2); alpha = 0.3: CANON near the window (K-closeout report section 3.2 / 3.4)
not_claimed: common K level; any statement about real GRAIL commission error (the field difference is dominated by frame/tide conventions, report section 3.2)
